\paragraph{Calibration and ranking audit of SG25-SG-combined-v1 (diagnostic only) (Sec.~125).} A CPU-only re-read of the stored per-image counts of all 204 cells (raw and R2) of SG25, SG27, SG30, SG31, SG32, SG33 and SG-combined-v1, asking whether COCO transfer gains reflect better spatial ranking or only threshold calibration. Each cell's frozen transfer is set beside a label-using best-threshold mIoU and a threshold-free raw-map AP. No image is regenerated; no result, threshold, selection or promotion changes.

\emph{Columns.} Frozen = registered result (VOC-selected threshold transferred unchanged to COCO). Best-threshold = cell and reference each take their best of the 17 thresholds on that dataset's own labels (optimistic, never a result; VOC is in-sample). Raw AP = mean per-image average precision of the raw 64x64 map with 20k paired bootstrap; threshold free, undefined for binary R2 masks. Gap = reference's COCO best-threshold minus frozen mIoU. Every delta is against the same package's same-stage reference. Cells: SG25 FINE-P2 (reference), COARSE32-P2 (both passes at 32x32, upsampled), 16-to-64 and 32-to-64 (coarse first pass, fine second pass); SG27 S0 (reference = FINE-P2), S8 (fine/16 min), S9 (fine x 16 product), S38 (three-way min); SG30 S0, S2 (second-pass inflation), S6 (S4 + pruning); SG31 S0, S1 (= SG25 16-to-64), S2 (continuous 16$\rightarrow$32$\rightarrow$64), S6 / S7 (background-gated), S10 (score squared); SG32 S0, S1 (fixed sharpening), S7 (c16 temperature); SG33 S0, H0 (ordinary hierarchy), H2 / H3 (stage residuals), M2 (IPF Markov source); SG-combined-v1 C0 (reference), C1 (ordinary hierarchy), C2 (exact KL 16$\rightarrow$32), C5 (relaxed both), C6 (exact both + completion), C8 (exact both + odds budget). +R2 = fixed DenseCRF. The same S ids mean different operators in different packages.

\emph{Finding.} Diagnostic only; every recomputed frozen mIoU matches the registered value to 1e-9. The fine reference is miscalibrated on COCO in every package: VOC threshold 0.425 (R2) / 0.45 (raw) vs COCO best 0.525, worth +0.027 / +0.020 mIoU. Hierarchy cells keep a COCO gain at matched thresholds (after R2: SG25 16$\rightarrow$64 +0.022, SG33 H2/H3 +0.021/+0.020, C2 +0.024, C6 +0.026) and raw AP rises for 16$\rightarrow$64, H2/H3 and C2. Sharpening wins (SG30 S2, SG32 S1) fall to about 0.000 and SG31 S6/S7/S10 to $\leq$ 0; S10's AP delta is exactly 0. C5/C6/C8 gain after R2 while raw AP falls; SG33 M2 ranks worse (COCO AP -0.037). Of 53 R2 cells with frozen COCO gain $\geq$ +0.015, 34 keep it at matched thresholds. Owner-reported; not yet independently audited.
